summary.text: Provide an official translation for documents in languages other than English.

steps.name: Provide a translation
steps.text: Provide an official translation for each document that is in a language other than English.

example_phrasings: Do I need to translate foreign-issued documents into English for the purpose of birth registration?
Do foreign documents need an English translation?
Must I provide official translations for documents not in English?

sources.page_title: Do I need to translate foreign-issued documents into English for the purpose of birth registration?

quotes.text: As with current procedures for submission of documents to ICA, you will need to provide official translation for documents in languages other than English.
you will need to provide official translation for documents in languages other than English.
